name: Max Estates Ltd
title: Max Estates Ltd - 544008 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q1 FY27 pre-sales Rs 1,100 cr (5x YoY) with Rs 13,500 cr contracted portfolio, but management withdrew sales guidance and consol PBT was only Rs 11 cr, so the read is cash-backed pipeline rather than hard earnings.

triggers.label: Sales guidance withdrawn
triggers.quote: So we have taken the path of not giving sales guidance and we will stick to that.

triggers.label: Q1 pre-sales Rs 1,100 cr, 5x YoY
triggers.quote: pre-sales of approximately Rs. 1,100 crores, registering a 5x year-on-year growth

triggers.label: FY27 collections Rs 2,500-2,700 cr
triggers.quote: we expect our collections to be in the range of Rs. 2,500-Rs. 2,700 crores in the current year

triggers.label: Residential volumes moderated sector-wide
triggers.quote: the residential sales volumes across the sector moderated through the quarter

guidance.quote: we expect our collections to be in the range of Rs. 2,500-Rs. 2,700 crores in the current year
We would be deploying close to Rs. 1,500-Rs. 1,800 crores on the project
continue to target an annual addition of 2 million square feet of residential development
we expect to achieve our annual rental income of approximately Rs. 700 crores at peak occupancy
we have taken the path of not giving sales guidance and we will stick to that

prior_guidance_check.quote: I do not want to lock ourselves by giving guidance

red_flags.label: Net debt up; construction debt rising
red_flags.quote: the debt which is going up is on account of the construction finance we have taken on the commercial assets

red_flags.label: Sales guidance withdrawn
red_flags.quote: I do not want to lock ourselves by giving guidance

red_flags.label: Related-party Antara fee 9.5% of topline
red_flags.quote: they get a 9.5% fee on the topline as a development manager for Max Estates

evasions.quote: we are not giving a guidance for FY '27
